TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'
root_cause: tests/llm/requirements.txt installs whowhatbench directly from the openvino.genai master branch with no version pin. An upstream change to whowhatbench's text_evaluator.py now invokes the generation callback (genai_gen_text) with an additional 'context' keyword argument that the repo's current genai_gen_text implementation does not accept, breaking every accuracy_conformance test on both CPU and GPU. This is unrelated to PR #39512, which only edits a benchmarks CSV file (docs/sphinx_setup/_static/benchmarks_files/llm_models_7-368H.csv); the same signature has now recurred 4 times since 2026-11-05, each time on an unrelated PR, confirming a persistent unpinned-dependency drift rather than a transient or PR-caused issue.
reproduction_steps: Install tests/llm/requirements.txt (pulls whowhatbench from openvino.genai@master) against the current genai_gen_text generation-function implementation, then run: python3 -m pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py -k CPU --tb native. The TypeError reproduces immediately on the first test case.
recommended_actions: Pin tests/llm/requirements.txt's whowhatbench dependency to a known-good commit/tag of openvino.genai instead of tracking master, or update genai_gen_text() to accept the new 'context' keyword argument used by whowhatbench.text_evaluator._generate_data.
Add a compatibility shim (**kwargs or an explicit context=None parameter) to genai_gen_text() in tests/llm so new optional arguments introduced by whowhatbench do not break the test suite.
Coordinate with openvino.genai / whowhatbench maintainers to confirm the intended signature change and align both repos before merging, then remove the unpinned master dependency.
prevention_strategies: Avoid unpinned 'git+https://...@master' test dependencies developed in lockstep with code under test; pin to a tag/commit and bump deliberately via CI, or add a contract test that fails fast with a clear message when the upstream function signature changes.
historical_context: This exact signature has now been seen 4 times (first seen 2026-11-05T06:17:40Z, most recent prior occurrence 2026-11-09T16:59:01Z on run 42647164506), always on unrelated PRs, confirming the break stems from an upstream whowhatbench update rather than any merge-queue PR content.
